THERMAL LIMIT OF THIS FOOTPRINT: measured 190 degC/W with tssop16's 6.96mm2 of pad copper and no thermal pad. At the full 0.52W continuous this package reaches 124 degC. The real DRV8833 is HTSSOP-16 with a PowerPAD and thermal vias; footprinter cannot express that pad, so this board is only valid at the duty cycle above. A continuous-duty build needs the PowerPAD part.
